debit.notes: Contact centre is 24x7 for urgent services such as card blocking and fraud reporting on toll-free 1800 5700 / 1800 5000 (IVR: 'Select option 1, To Report loss of card, to report a fraud or to report an Unauthorized transaction not done by you'). Overseas: domestic customers calling from abroad 24X7 on +91 79-66296009; NRIs from overseas locations 24x7 on +91 79-66296629. App path: bob World — login > More > Debit card block/hotlist (Under Quick Actions); netbanking: bob World Internet — Services > My Accounts > Debit Card Blocking; self blocking/debit freezing via the Online Account Blocking Portal. On fraud: 'immediately block respective channel or Freeze the Account for Debit Transactions' — channel-block email channelblock@bankofbaroda.bank.in. 1800 102 5627 / bobsupport@cardbranch.com is the Gift/Pre-paid/Reloadable-card line, not a debit or credit block line. No SMS keyword block is published for debit cards, and the page does not mention the 1930 helpline.

credit.notes: BOBCARD Ltd (the bank's credit-card subsidiary) runs these channels. FAQ 'How to block my card?': the microsite takes the last 4 digits of the BOBCARD, registered mobile number and date of birth, then an OTP to the registered mobile — choose 'Temporary Block card', or 'Yes, Block card' with Select Reason for Block 'Lost/Stolen'. Same flow via BOBCARD Mobile App or https://online.bobcard.co.in/ — scroll to 'My Card Services' > 'Card Block/Unblock'. FAQ lists 'BOBCARD toll free numbers 1800 2665 100 / 1800 2667 100' and, in its terms, 'write to crm@bobcard.co.in or contact us at our Toll Free Nos. 1800 2090, 1800 1210'. The FAQ page publishes no SMS block keyword, no overseas number, and no hours statement.

upi.notes: Instant freeze: SMS 'BOBUPIBLK' to 8422009988 — 'To block UPI services instantly: Go to SMS option in your registered mobile device. Type BOBUPIBLK in the message content (keyword is not case sensitive). Send the SMS to 8422009988 (Service Mobile Number).' bob इ Pay (bank's own UPI app, ex-BHIM Baroda Pay): freeze via De-register — 'You can go to the option De-register available in side-menu'; caveat per bank FAQ: 'once de-registered you cannot register with same Virtual ID', fresh registration required. Entering wrong UPI PIN 3+ times: 'Account will be blocked for 24 hrs'; repeat blocks permanently. Phone: 1800 5700 / 1800 5000 (24x7 toll-free; contact-centre services list includes 'UPI & digital banking assistance'); IVR: 'Select option 1, To Report loss of card, to report a fraud or to report an Unauthorized transaction not done by you'. On fraud the bank says to 'immediately block respective channel or Freeze the Account for Debit Transactions by calling Bank's Toll-Free No. 1800 5700 / 1800 5000 or visiting Bank's Web Portal or Branch'; channel-block email channelblock@bankofbaroda.bank.in, UPI desk upi.bcc@bankofbaroda.co.in. The page's transaction-limits table lists 'USSD (*99#)' as a Pay channel (₹5,000 per txn/day) — a payment mention, not a block mechanism. No netbanking UPI-disable path is published on the bank's pages.
